text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGERS: High p99 latency on /v1/chat/completions across us-west-2 cluster (ongoing)

mira: I'm on it. seeing a p99 jump to ~3.2s for the chat route, p95 ~800ms. is this traffic-related or model-specific?

sam: Traffic spike from a bursty customer is visible but not huge — requests spiked ~2.5x for a 10m window. The tail looks model-dependent: mistral-1-fast shows most of the p99s.

jamie: grabbing traces. early hypothesis: some hosts hit long GC + kernel preemption during warmups, causing KV cache misses and higher token latency.

mira: mitigation options: 1) temporary routing to cheaper-but-lower-latency model variant (mistral-1-rt) for that tenant, 2) squelch/raise p99 alert for that route during active mitigation, 3) vertically drain problematic hosts. thoughts?

tia: from product: need to minimize user-visible tail latency. Option 1 sounds OK if we can route only the affected customer. Can we do per-tenant routing quickly?

sam: yes, we can add a route override rule for that tenant within ~5m. I'll open a canary and monitor.

oliver: FYI a customer success rep reported 2 paid customers saw timeouts in the last 20m. we should keep them informed.

jamie: I've started a host drain of node ip-10-0-45-12 and ip-10-0-45-13 — they had the highest stall counts.

mira: ok implementing two parts: (A) add temporary routing override to mistral-1-rt for tenant:ten-42, (B) silence the noisy p99 pager rule for /v1/chat/completions in us-west-2 with a 30min squelch so we don't page while draining/redirecting.

sam: pushing route override now. command: 

```bash
# route override for tenant ten-42
redwoodctl routes apply --tenant ten-42 --route "/v1/chat/completions" --model mistral-1-rt --duration 30m
```

sam: done — traffic shows 75% of ten-42 shifted within the next 30s. tail latency for that tenant down to ~700ms p99.

mira: squelch alert: 

```
# alert rule id: latency-chat-completions-p99-usw2
squelch --rule latency-chat-completions-p99-usw2 --duration 30m --reason "post-pager mitigation: tenant routing + host draining"
```

mira: squelch issued. :white_check_mark: We'll still keep silent logs and a slack-only notify to the channel for visibility.

jamie: host drains look good, garbage collectors finished and KV cache warmed on new hosts. cluster p99 trending back toward 900ms.

tia: can we make this more surgical long-term? product wants per-route & per-model thresholds rather than a single cluster-wide p99. also want a dashboard tile to track p95/p99 split by model.

sam: agree. immediate follow-ups I'll file: 1) split alert rule into per-model per-route groups, 2) add a dashboard with p50/p95/p99 by model and by route, 3) add a runbook section for "route override" + "squelch" steps.

mira: quick draft of alert adjustment proposal:

- keep p95 global route alert at 600ms (wider sensitivity to load)
- change p99 to be per-model per-route: default p99 thresholds: general-family models 1200ms, low-latency rt-family 700ms, large-family 2000ms
- add suppression: only page if p99 breach persists for 2 consecutive 1m windows AND error-rate < 2% (to avoid paging floods during error storms)

jamie: +1 to the suppression rule. Also recommend a backoff squelch so repeated short incidents from a noisy tenant don't page the same oncall repeatedly. e.g., automatic 1h squelch after 3 pages in 24h for the same route/tenant.

oliver: can we include customer-impact tags in alerts so SRE/product can quickly prioritize? e.g., "customers_affected: high/medium/low" derived from active sessions.

sam: yep we'll emit a dimension in the alert payload and surface it in the dashboard.

mira: jotted down runbook links and tickets:
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/chat-latency-mitigation
- Dashboard ticket: RDW-3245 (sam)
- Alert refactor ticket: RDW-3246 (mira)
- Customer comms: CS-572 (oliver)

deploy-bot: deploy started for platform-alerts-refactor commit abc123 — rolling patch to alert rules (no infra reboot)

sam: I'll land a conservative change set tonight: split alert into per-model buckets and add the 2-window suppressor. won't flip default pages until we've validated on dashboards.

mira: action items summary:
1) sam: complete dashboard RDW-3245 and attach visual validation (ETA 24h)
2) mira: file detailed alert thresholds and implementation RDW-3246 (ETA 48h)
3) jamie: add host-level GC/kv-warm metrics to the dashboard (ETA 24h)
4) oliver: draft customer note referencing CS-572 (ETA 2h for initial outreach)
5) all: postmortem entry if trend reappears (standard incident tagging)

tia: thanks everyone. please add any additional notes here. we'll reconvene in the postmortem channel once alerts are refactored. :thumbsup:
